name: Füssen
tagline: Neuschwanstein and the castles of King Ludwig
summary: Füssen is the Bavarian town at the end of the Romantic Road, beneath King Ludwig II's fairy-tale Neuschwanstein Castle. Tour Neuschwanstein and the yellow Hohenschwangau, see the castle from Mary's Bridge, swim in the Alpsee, and visit Ludwig's Linderhof palace and the painted village of Oberammergau.
seasonNote: Summer is busy; autumn colours and snowy winters are lovely. Mary's Bridge closes in ice.
arrival: Trains from Munich take about 2 hours; buses run from Füssen station to the castles.
gettingAround: Bus 73 or 78 to Hohenschwangau; walk or horse carriage up to Neuschwanstein.
cashTip: Carry some cash; many small places still prefer it.
foodTip: Käsespätzle, roast pork, pretzels and Bavarian beer.
buyTip: Füssen lutes and violins history, and Bavarian crafts.
